rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for doing something in an explosive manner, especially describing rapid growth or change.

example.english: This company’s business grew explosively; it was truly unexpected.
example.traditional: 呢間公司嘅生意爆炸性咁增長，真係估唔到。
